VALIDATION_LATENCY.definition: Shortest directed dependency-path edge count from an information node to the earliest reachable validation gate that explicitly covers that information.

UNVALIDATED_EXPOSURE.definition: Count of downstream semantic nodes reached strictly before the earliest validating gate.

ROLLBACK_SPAN.definition: Count of downstream information or artifact nodes materialized strictly before the earliest validating gate.

future_calibration.rule: Do not activate bounded penalties or rewards until calibration against representative playbooks and anti-farming regressions is complete.
